summary: Independent EvidenceGate review found two fail-closed gaps: PlanDraft validation accepts negative maxCostUsd and CodexSDKDriver can pass through PlanDraft without an explicit output contract.

criteria.criterion: Planner roles receive read-only runtime profiles and no project write grants.
criteria.notes: Planner runtime profile is read_only and adapter validation rejects direct project write/tool execution capability grants in the reviewed path.

criteria.criterion: Malformed, uncovered, cyclic, over-budget or over-privileged drafts fail before execution.
criteria.notes: Budget fail-closed is incomplete: a PlanDraft with node budgetRequest.maxCostUsd=-100.0 is accepted by PlannerOutputValidator with PlannerBudgetLimits(max_cost_usd=1.0), producing accepted=True and a PlanIR containing negative maxCostUsd. This contradicts the plan-draft/plan-ir schema minimum 0 and lets cost totals be offset.

criteria.criterion: Planner input and output are content-addressed Artifacts with release and Context Manifest digests.
criteria.notes: Planner context and planner artifacts are deterministic and bind release/context manifest digests; manifest hashes for published TASK-0030 evidence matched local content.

criteria.criterion: Fixture planner tests are deterministic and do not require an external account.
criteria.notes: Fixture planner tests are deterministic and use no external account.

criteria.criterion: Optional model adapter failures are structured and cannot silently fall back to a different driver.
criteria.notes: CodexSDKDriver only validates request.output_contract when one is supplied, while parse_reference_output returns raw PlanDraft/PlanPatchDraft/AcceptanceDraft mappings. A direct planner request with expected_output=PlanDraft and output_contract=None accepted {'kind':'PlanDraft'} instead of structured failure. This violates the explicit output-contract boundary claimed for the optional model adapter.

criteria.criterion: A Defect can produce a bounded PlanPatchDraft while unchanged nodes and Evidence remain referenced.
criteria.notes: Defect-triggered repair patch validation enforces trigger/cycle bounds and requires reusedEvidenceRefs when unchanged nodes are retained.
